name: debugging_basic
description: Buggy functions with failing tests; the model must return corrected code that passes.

cases.code:
def last_n(items, n):
    return items[len(items) - n - 1:]
cases.tests:
assert last_n([1,2,3,4], 2) == [3,4]
assert last_n([1], 1) == [1]
assert last_n([1,2], 0) == []

cases.error: Second call add_item(2) returned [1, 2] instead of [2]
cases.tests:
assert add_item(1) == [1]
assert add_item(2) == [2]
assert add_item(3, [0]) == [0, 3]

cases.code:
import time

def is_expired(expires_at, now=None):
    now = time.time() if now is None else now
    return now < expires_at
cases.error: is_expired(100, now=50) returned True for a token that is still valid
cases.tests:
assert is_expired(100, now=150) is True
assert is_expired(100, now=50) is False
